notes.title: Announcing Elevator Down!
notes.content:
Greetings Party!

I hope you enjoyed your adventures across Kaltrion because we are now moving beyond this world!

Yes, exactly! The Afterlife!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866290/Elevator_Down/

Our new game, Elevator Down takes place in the Afterlife!

Did you enjoy the humour of Bn'B but wanted it a smidge darker?

Would you like:

 More gameplay?
 More impactful choices?
 More dating options?
 Way larger playtime?
 To stamp countless envelopes?
 To meet the Grim Reaper?
 To figure out if God is real?
 To delve into the depths of your own mortality in search of answers that might never have existed in the first place?
 A game that's a bit like Paper's Please but with sexier characters?

Then Elevator Down is for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866290/Elevator_Down/

What are you waiting for?
Wishlist Now to join our next comedic journey! 

And don't worry we'll get back to Kaltrion when the time is right! (when we find enough money so we don't starve)
